substeps.caption: Opentrons' own CAD of the OT-2. Its door, windows and frame fade, and the head's cover too, to show the P300 pipette on the right mount and a P20 on the left.
The gantry slides forward and the head along it, to the tip rack in slot 1. The pipette comes down and presses its nozzle into tip A1.
It lifts the tip out, crosses to the deep-well plate in slot 2 and draws up 300 uL from well H1. The plate is cut through row H, so the level can be seen dropping.
Over the 96-well plate in slot 3 it dispenses the 300 uL into well H1.
Then over the fixed trash in slot 12, the pipette pushes the used tip off, and it drops into the bin.
The head goes back to where it started, ready for the next tip.
